Description: Staged AnoX commerce quotes, blocked checkout attempts and owned order foundation. No merchant orders, payments or webhook route.

ExistingHttpApiId.Description: Existing HTTP API; verify in us-east-2 before deployment. This stack owns only its new /commerce routes.

ExistingAuthorizerId.Description: Existing Cognito JWT authorizer ID; read and verify issuer/audience before deployment.

CognitoIssuer.Description: Verified existing Cognito issuer URL; deliberately no guessed default.

CognitoClientId.Description: Existing frontend Cognito app client; must match the JWT authorizer audience.

CatalogFunctionArn.Description: Existing catalog Lambda with the reviewed IAM-only commerce.product handler deployed first.

ReservedConcurrency.Description: Bounds downstream pressure; account concurrency quota must be checked.

ExistingAlarmTopicArn.Description: Optional existing authorized SNS alarm topic. Empty creates alarms without notifications.

Properties.AlarmDescription: The commerce handler is returning unavailable responses. No customer data is included.
An unhandled commerce Lambda error occurred.
Commerce p99 duration approaches its 18-second runtime limit.
Commerce write consumption reaches 10,000 capacity units per hour. This is a usage alert, not a provider invoice.
